messages:
mina: noticed the ESM quickstart failing on Vercel Edge with TS errors: 'RequestInit' vs 'Request' and overload resolution for client.chat.generate<T>. anyone seen this pattern?

olav: yup. usually a types resolver mismatch: project picks CJS .d.ts while Edge expects DOM fetch types. package.json 'types' + exports can point at the wrong bundle.

tanya: also check overloads. if our APIs use an `unknown`-heavy shape, TS can't infer generics and falls back to a non-generic overload. that explains the 'no overload matches' noise.

mina: sample uses tsconfig {"module":"ESNext","moduleResolution":"bundler","lib":["DOM","ES2021"]} and still fails in preview.

olav: short fixes: point sample package.json "types" to dist/esm/index.d.ts, add recommended tsconfig note in quickstart, and set skipLibCheck: true in examples as a temporary workaround.

tanya: typing fix options: collapse the two overloads into one inferable signature or add a lightweight helper wrapper that exposes friendlier types (eg. createLoose) while keeping strict internals.

mina: can someone open PR to pin types in the sample, add docs, and add a DTS smoke test in CI running against the edge ESM matrix? I'll triage.

olav: I'll do the package.json/types + docs. tanya: can you draft the typing change RFC and include dts tests?

tanya: on it. I'll also add a note about avoiding deep 'unknown' in public d.ts and keeping runtime-checking boundaries internal.

build-bot: CI queued for branch olav/esm-types-pin (job 6110).

mina: thanks — this blocks a customer trial so high priority. keep updates here and ping when PRs are ready. :thumbsup:
